topic: Discrete Convolutions: From Image Blurring to Feature Detection

sections.title: Intuitive Hook: The 'Moving Window' Concept
lecture_lines: Convolution is a sliding window operator.
Imagine a 3x3 filter passing over pixels.
Multiply pixel values by filter weights.
Sum results to produce new pixel value.
animations: Display 5x5 grid (color: #FFFFFF) with center coordinates and a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/monitor.svg] icon to represent the input matrix.
Display 3x3 red (#FF0000) square outline around top-left 3x3 pixels.
Animate red outline sliding row-by-row across the 5x5 grid.
Show math symbol: Input (color: #FFFFFF) * Filter (color: #FF0000) = Output (color: #00FFFF).
Flash the output cell when window moves to a new position, represented by a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/camera.svg] icon capturing the result.

sections.title: Application: Feature Detection in Computer Vision
lecture_lines: Positive and negative values identify edges.
High contrast yields strong signal response.
animations: Display edge detection kernel (color: #FF5500) moving across.
Show resulting feature map [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/camera.svg] (color: #00FF00) emphasizing vertical edges.
